This Finance Business Partner role is a foundational hire that will directly support the CFO in this journey, combining analytical rigor with hands-on model building and presentation craft to keep leadership fast and informed. The role spans the full breadth of TAC's finance operations, offering a rare opportunity to gain hands-on exposure across business controlling, financial reporting, systems, and strategic finance in a single position. As TAC grows, so does the scope: this role is designed to evolve with the business and the individual. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Financial Modelling & Analysis •        Maintain and continuously improve rolling forecast models, budget-vs-actual trackers, and scenario analysis tools in Excel. •        Perform variance analysis across Revenue, Gross Margin, EBIT, and Cash — with clear narrative explanations for management. •        Build and update sensitivity models to support CFO scenario planning and board-level decision-making. •        Prepare month-end close packs: input data, validate outputs, and flag anomalies for senior review. •        Support core accounting activities alongside the team — journal entry preparation, general ledger reconciliations, and accruals review — building a foundation in bookkeeping and statutory reporting over time. Reporting & Presentation •        Design and maintain weekly/monthly performance dashboards in Excel and Power BI. •        Prepare leadership presentation decks (PowerPoint) under CFO direction. •        Draft financial commentary and KPI narratives for internal and external audiences. •        Compile business review materials for monthly leadership meetings. Systems & Data Management •        Manage and maintain data feeds, databases, and financial reporting systems (ERP and adjacent tools) — operating autonomously without a dedicated IT team. •        Own ERP system activities directly: data entry validation, reconciliation checks, report extraction, and basic configuration. •        Build and maintain structured data repositories to support clean, audit-ready financial records. •        Independently set up and manage reporting automation tools (Power Automate, Excel macros, Power BI) to streamline recurring workflows. •        Co-lead process automation / digitalization of finance activities to shift workload toward value-added analytics. KEY COMPETENCIES Accuracy & Rigor •        Extreme attention to detail and data accuracy — numbers must be right the first time. •        Financial modelling fundamentals; Excel mastery — modelling, pivot tables, advanced formulas. •        Analytical curiosity and structured problem-solving. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het beheer, de uitvoering en het kwaliteitsmanagement van dit IFM-contract. Onze klant is een toonaangevend farmaceutisch bedrijf waar we internationaal partner zijn op facilitair gebied. In deze rol rapporteer je in onze matrix structuur aan zowel het internationale Key Account Management als de organisatie in Nederland. Wat ga je doen? Jij bent hét aanspreekpunt voor één van onze strategische klanten in Nederland. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en optimalisatie van het integrale facilitaire contract. Samen met het team op de klantlocatie zorg je voor hoogwaardige dienstverlening en sterke financiële en operationele prestaties. Met jouw leiderschap weet je te inspireren en te verbinden. Je bouwt aan een duurzame klantrelatie en creëert betrokkenheid binnen het team. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden omvatten onder andere: Verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, kwantiteit, tijdigheid en kostenbewaking van alle geleverde diensten volgens de contractafspraken. Financieel verantwoordelijk voor de resultaten binnen de contractuele kaders. Coachen en motiveren van de Site Managers/Facilitair Managers en het team op de klantlocatie. Inzicht verkrijgen in de behoeften van de klant en gebruikers, en dit vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen in onze dienstverlening. Contractbeheer verzorgen en relaties onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, waaronder de klant en leveranciers. Kunnen schakelen tussen team, klant en leveranciers op zowel strategisch als operationeel niveau. Wat neem je mee? Bij Apleona geloven we in potentieel. We kijken niet alleen naar diploma’s, maar vooral naar wie je bent en wat je kunt. Voor een goede start zijn de volgende kwalificaties gewenst: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in facilitair management of vergelijkbare ervaring. Minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare leidinggevende ervaring. Ervaring met het aansturen van facilitaire diensten binnen een IFM-omgeving. Ervaring met werken in een internationale context en contracten; Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om klantbehoeften goed te vertalen. Analytisch en accuraat, met het vermogen om knelpunten tijdig te signaleren. In bezit van VCA-VOL, of bereid deze te behalen. Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office; ervaring met Navision of een ander ERP-systeem is een pré. Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift. Ambitie om mee te groeien met Apleona en nieuwe kansen binnen het account te ontwikkelen. Wat bieden wij je? Apleona biedt een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden én veel ruimte voor groei. Ruimte om door te groeien en te sparren met vakgenoten. Over Apleona Apleona is een internationaal toonaangevende Integrated Facility Management specialist. review_candidates.title: Business Development Director, Institutional
review_candidates.description: About the Opportunity A well-established global asset manager — part of a larger, listed financial services group with a multi-decade track record and deep institutional roots — is building its Asia Pacific institutional distribution franchise from Singapore. This is the firm's first dedicated asset management hire in the region: a hands-on, frontline sales seat for someone who has already sold public markets investment products to institutional investors across APAC. You will have the backing of a global platform — investment, product, portfolio management, marketing, legal, compliance, and RFP support across the US and Europe — but in-region, you are building from the ground up. The APAC mandate is product-led, with a clear priority on long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, and quantitative equity strategies . Liquid alternatives and credit-related strategies sit within the broader platform, but the core of this seat is opening institutional doors and converting mandates for listed / liquid asset management products. Singapore is the regional base. You will build the APAC client base starting from your own institutional relationships across Singapore, Korea, and the broader region. The Role This is a frontline institutional business development role — not a team-management seat, a regional figurehead position, or a relationship-maintenance desk. You will: Originate and close new institutional business across long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, and quantitative equity strategies, and related listed / liquid asset management products Build relationships with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, investment consultants, central banks, private banks, and other institutional allocators across APAC Lead the full sales cycle — from first engagement and investor education through due diligence, RFP / DDQ, and mandate award Represent the firm credibly with CIOs, investment teams, consultants, and institutional decision-makers Work with global product specialists, portfolio managers, marketing, legal, compliance, and RFP teams to support client conversations Provide market intelligence on APAC investor appetite, competitor positioning, pricing, and product demand You will report into senior asset management leadership overseas. You will have global support, but you will not inherit a local APAC book or a local sales team. The expectation is simple: operate independently, earn the trust of institutional investors, and turn relationships into measurable AUM growth. What Makes You a Fit You have likely spent 10–15 years in institutional asset management sales, business development, and relationship management — and you can point to mandates you personally originated and closed, not just relationships you maintained. You will probably recognise yourself in most of the following: You have sold public markets asset management products to institutional investors in APAC, and you can name the investor type, product, market, and AUM raised You have specific experience distributing long-only equity, factor-based, smart beta, systematic, or quantitative equity strategies Your recent coverage has been direct institutional — sovereign wealth funds, pensions, insurers, investment consultants, central banks, private banks — rather than retail or advisor / intermediary channels You can hold your own with a CIO, consultant, or investment committee on equity strategy positioning, factor exposures, portfolio construction, performance drivers, risk, and the due-diligence questions that follow You are a hunter who is comfortable building a market from scratch, without inherited accounts or a large local infrastructure You hold a degree in Economics, Business, Mathematics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field — a Master's or MBA is a plus You are based in Singapore, or can be quickly. Singapore Citizenship or Permanent Residency is preferred It would be an advantage if you also bring: Liquid alternatives distribution experience ETF, index, or smart beta distribution experience Korea, Japan, or broader North Asia institutional coverage US CLO or credit product distribution experience MAS Capital Markets Services Registered Representative status What Is On Offer A founding APAC institutional distribution seat within a global asset management platform A product-led mandate focused on listed / liquid investment strategies, with full global investment and product support The opportunity to build a regional franchise from Singapore and shape the firm's APAC presence from day one A performance-linked compensation structure designed to reward new business growth
